remarks: Discover the perfect blend of space, convenience, and value in this fantastic 2-bedroom, 1 bath unit where ALL UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED! This incredibly spacious unit features a bright and open living area that flows seamlessly into a large, updated kitchen equipped with modern stainless steel appliances, an abundance of cabinet space, and a dining area. Enjoy the comfort of two spacious bedrooms, an updated bathroom, and the ultimate convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. This unit also includes 2 dedicated parking spaces. Ideally located, you'll be just minutes from local parks, the train, major highways, Chelsea Piers, and a fantastic variety of local shops and restaurants.
